Rishi / Karthik —

Looping Karthik (legal ops) so we have alignment. Quick guidance:
- Offer two concrete 30–45m times and include an option for late afternoon to accommodate East Coast folks.
- If HelioBank keeps the data residency ask (EU-only clause), flag impact to pricing — ask for specifics so we can prepare a short memo.
- If procurement needs an exec-level credit or SLA concession to close this week, run it by me first before committing.

I would phrase the follow-up politely but with urgency: we need a short working session to agree on exact language to get this over the line. Keep the DocuSign deadline in the email to motivate scheduling.

Hi Rishi — apologies for the no-show on Thursday. We had an unexpected internal escalation with a vendor that took our legal and procurement leads offline. My bad for not updating you — that should not have happened.

We do want to get this across the finish line. Attached is a commented PDF with our in-line notes (HelioBank_Redlines_v3_comments.pdf). There are two items we want to resolve in the working session:
1) Data residency: we are requesting a clause that requires EU-only storage for certain customer classes; we will send proposed language before the call.
2) Audit logs & retention: minor language tweaks and a question about retention period for logs (we prefer 7 years).

Proposed times (PST):
- Monday 2026-12-07 09:30–10:00
- Monday 2026-12-07 16:00–16:30

If neither works, Tuesday 2026-12-08 10:00–10:45 PST also works for our legal lead Tom. Please confirm what works and share an updated calendar invite.

DocuSign link (preliminary) is ready, we want to target signature by EOD 12/10 if language is agreed.

Thanks for the flexibility, and sorry again for the disruption.

Nina Alvarez
Sr. Procurement Manager | HelioBank
